description: MainActivity.kt defines the main activity for an Android application which hosts navigation between login, overview, and list fragments. It manages user authentication state, UI updates, and navigation logic within the app.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity hosting navigation, authentication, and fragment management.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets layout, toolbar, and initial fragment based on authentication state.

methods.name: wireNavigation
methods.description: Binds click listeners to navigation buttons to handle user navigation and authentication actions.

methods.name: ensureSignedIn
methods.description: Checks if user is signed in; if not, redirects to login; otherwise executes the given action.

methods.name: navigateToLogin
methods.description: Replaces current fragment with the LoginFragment and updates the action bar title.

methods.name: navigateToOverview
methods.description: Replaces current fragment with the OverviewFragment and updates the action bar title.

methods.name: navigateToList
methods.description: Replaces current fragment with a ListFragment for a specified kind and updates the title accordingly.

methods.name: updateAuthButton
methods.description: Updates the login/logout button text based on the user's authentication state.

methods.name: onSignedIn
methods.description: Callback invoked upon successful sign-in; updates UI and navigates to overview.
